name: ESP32 client (4-bpp grayscale .bin)
description: Composition PNG dithered to 16-level grayscale and packed into a 4-bpp raw buffer the ESP32 firmware streams straight to the IT8951 controller's image buffer. Targets the Seeed reTerminal E1003 (10.3" 1872x1404 monochrome ePaper with 16-level greyscale) and any other IT8951-driven greyscale panel. Published retained to tesserae/<device_id>/frame/bin so a freshly-woken client sees the current frame on first wake.

settings.name: contrast
settings.label: Pre-dither contrast
settings.help: Push midtones toward black or white before the dither pass. 1.0 leaves the image alone; > 1.0 deepens contrast (good for photos with grey skies); < 1.0 softens (good for text-heavy dashboards).
